verses.arabicText: حمٓ
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.translation: By the clear Book

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innā anzalnāhu fī laylatim-mubārakatin innā kunnā mundhirīn
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺

verses.arabicText: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.translation: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

verses.arabicText: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.translation: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

verses.arabicText: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Raḥmatam-min rabbika innahu huwa s-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—

verses.arabicText: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbi s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīn
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith

verses.arabicText: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīn
verses.translation: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers

verses.arabicText: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translation: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves

verses.arabicText: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translation: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible

verses.arabicText: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translation: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment

verses.arabicText: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbanā ik'shif ʿannā l-ʿadhāba innā mu'minūn
verses.translation: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

verses.arabicText: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Annā lahumu dh-dhik'rā waqad jāahum rasūlum-mubīnun
verses.translation: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā kāshifū l-ʿadhābi qalīlan innakum ʿāidūn
verses.translation: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma nabṭishu l-baṭshata l-kub'rā innā muntaqimūn
verses.translation: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma fir'ʿawna wajāahum rasūlun karīmun
verses.translation: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them

verses.arabicText: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: An addū ilayya ʿibāda l-lahi innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
verses.translation: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.arabicText: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-al-lā taʿlū ʿalā l-lahi innī ātīkum bisul'ṭānim-mubīnin
verses.translation: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum an tarjumūn
verses.translation: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺

verses.arabicText: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.translation: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

verses.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.translation: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”

verses.arabicText: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translation: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued

verses.arabicText: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.translation: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”

verses.arabicText: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind

verses.arabicText: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
verses.translation: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences

verses.arabicText: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
verses.translation: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translation: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people

verses.arabicText: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā bakat ʿalayhimu s-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīn
verses.translation: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīn
verses.translation: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

verses.arabicText: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyam-mina l-mus'rifīn
verses.translation: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others

verses.arabicText: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāom-mubīnun
verses.translation: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīn
verses.translation: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected

verses.arabicText: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

verses.arabicText: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿiw-wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīn
verses.translation: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqnā s-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

verses.arabicText: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translation: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿam-mawlan shayaw-walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.translation: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Illā mar-raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu r-raḥīm
verses.translation: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translation: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

verses.arabicText: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.translation: will be the food of the evildoer

verses.arabicText: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.translation: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

verses.arabicText: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: like the boiling of hot water

verses.arabicText: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīm
verses.translation: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”

verses.arabicText: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.translation: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūn
verses.translation: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

verses.arabicText: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.translation: amid Gardens and springs

verses.arabicText: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.translation: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.translation: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

verses.arabicText: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.translation: There they will call for every fruit in serenity

verses.arabicText: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verses.translation: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

verses.arabicText: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Faḍlam-min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful

verses.arabicText: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.translation: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting
